intentional_boundaries: Go's launch-label scan is not copied: the existing Rust one-use SpawnRegistrationProof and launch lease remain authoritative.
Startup containment is stronger than Go's direct Process.Kill: owned Unix startup groups and Windows Jobs terminate ordinary descendants before registration.
Startup accepts only already-open private file handles. Opening/log-name selection and any source-compatible null-output fallback belong to the caller.

Pre-ACK ownership disarm avoids killing an acknowledged wrapper during Hub shutdown. An uncertain ACK/drop detaches; a known pre-send failure can explicitly abort. The normal wrapper registration deadline bounds an unacknowledged child.
The provider PTY has a separate owner/group/Job. These startup tests do not replace provider PTY, full HTTP/WebSocket, installed-home, external-provider or native-platform acceptance.
